name: United States
intro: Explore the diverse landscapes of the United States. From the soaring skyscrapers of Manhattan to the massive sandstone canyons of Utah, the USA is a continent-spanning journey.
bestSeason: September to November (Autumn foliage) & April to June (Spring)
weather: Diverse climate. Warm sunny days in California, hot dry desert sun in Utah, and snowy cold winters in the northern states.
visaInfo: Tourist visa required for Indian passport holders prior to arrival.
flightDuration: Approx 15-18 hours flight from major Indian airports.
highlights: Fly by private helicopter over the Manhattan skyline in New York
Gaze at the massive red rock walls of the Grand Canyon
Drive a luxury convertible along the Pacific Coast Highway in California
Stay in architectural desert retreats in Canyon Point, Utah
